name: Xtream Bridge
overview: Xtream Live TV, VOD movies and automatic EPG
description: Xtream-compatible panel integration with separate Live TV and VOD switches, category selection and automatic XMLTV EPG. Targets Jellyfin 12.3. Mock-panel tested; real-server playback not yet verified.
